summary: Grand livre détaillé (ledger) feature validated end-to-end. All 6 backend tests pass: template download (headers correct), full CRUD cycle on unlocked 2026-06 (upload -> status imported:true -> AI variance callable -> delete -> status imported:false), lock enforcement on both POST and DELETE (HTTP 403 with French 'verrouillé' message), invalid upload handling (non-xlsx and empty file -> HTTP 400 with helpful French message referencing columns), and non-regression on /acct/bilan and /acct/pnl. Cleanup verified: 2026-06 is locked=true, ledger_count cleared, no test ledger remains, account_count=489 preserved, balanced=true. Frontend Comptabilité > Balance de vérification page renders acct-ledger-card, acct-ledger-status, acct-ledger-input (hidden file input, wrapped by Importer button — expected), and acct-ledger-template-btn correctly, with French-only labels and OPTIONNEL badge, and shows 'Aucun grand livre pour ce mois' status for a fresh period.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~3020 lines — consider splitting Comptabilité routes into a dedicated module for maintainability (already flagged in earlier iterations).

acct_ledger_status and acct_delete_ledger use get_current_user (any authenticated user). Deletion of a ledger is a destructive op; consider write_guard/require_admin_or_editor consistency with BV endpoints (BV upload also uses get_current_user, so this is consistent — but worth confirming vs role matrix).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test cycle unlocked 2026-06, uploaded a temporary ledger (6 txns / 2 accounts), then deleted and re-locked. State restored to baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ledger feature is stable. For AI variance, test uses tolerant assertion on ledger_used since the AI response shape may vary; main agent has already manually verified ledger_used:true and outlier citation (GEANT -145000). If deeper AI validation is needed, extend test_full_ledger_cycle to assert ledger_used==True explicitly after upload.
